chooser.title: Choose your platform
chooser.dialog_note: Downloads start directly from the official {version} build.

windows.label: Windows
windows.install_note: Run the setup file. If Windows flags an unrecognized publisher, verify the official CaveViewer download and inspect the warning before proceeding.

macos.label: macOS
macos.install_note: Choose your Mac type, then drag CaveViewer into Applications.
macos.help: Check Apple menu → About This Mac. Look for “Chip” or “Processor.”

linux.label: Linux
linux.install_note: Allow the AppImage to run in your file manager, then open it.
